CopySprig notes

Privacy

Updated October 2, 2026.

The text you enter

Text transformation, searching and copying run in your browser. CopySprig does not upload entered text or clipboard contents. We do not retain your custom phrases in saved selections. A clipboard operation writes the result to your device’s clipboard only when you choose Copy.

Local storage

Your browser may store identifiers for saved styles, saved symbols and up to eight recent selections. These records stay on your device. Use Clear saved or Clear recent in the tool, or clear the site’s browser data, to remove them. If optional analytics is configured, a local preference records your choice. A browser analytics exclusion uses a local preference and a first-party preference cookie; neither contains your text.

Hosting

Firebase Hosting serves the site over HTTPS. Like other hosting providers, Google may process technical request data such as IP address and request details under its own policies. See Firebase privacy information and Google’s privacy policy.

Optional analytics

Google Analytics is configured but loads only if you allow analytics. It counts page visits, copying and favorite selections using fixed style or symbol identifiers. It never receives the input text, generated output, clipboard contents, search words or URL parameters. Google may process device and request data. Choose Decline to keep analytics off; use Analytics choices to revisit the choice. If you previously allowed analytics and want to withdraw consent immediately, decline, reload the page, and clear this site’s cookies in your browser. To exclude every visit and action from this browser even if analytics was previously allowed, exclude this browser from analytics. The preference persists until you clear this site’s data; set it again on each browser or device you use.

Advertising

Advertising is currently inactive. We do not load advertising scripts or set advertising cookies. Before advertising is activated, this policy and the consent setup must be updated for the actual provider. Optional analytics consent does not authorize advertising.

External links

External services have their own privacy policies. We do not operate those services. Avoid posting private text in public project reports.

Contact and requests

For a bug report, a missing symbol or a privacy question, use the CopySprig project contact channel. Please do not include private text or account details in a public report.
